These files are vendored from the IsMyPhonePwned website’s idevice-rs advanced WebUSB UI (`assets/idevice-workspace-*.html/css` and `idevice-demo-app.js`). The workspace HTML is the shared body fragment with About wording aligned to `iphone-advanced.html`; the demo app is wrapped so MobiPwn can call `bootIphoneAdvanced()` after mounting the markup instead of auto-running at module load.
